data.description:
## Summary

The "Live External Integration" workflow (external-integration.yml) has 4 failing job lanes —
`external LLM (live anthropic)`, `external LLM (live openai)`, `external LLM (live bedrock)`,
and `langfuse tracing round-trip` — all failing with:

    AttributeError: module 'rebar.llm' has no attribute 'review_ticket'

## Root cause (proven)

The public `rebar.llm.review_ticket()` API was REMOVED in a pre-1.0 breaking pass (deprecated
v0.11.0, removed 2026-08-12; CHANGELOG.md:121, docs/release-notes.md:72 maps it ->
`rebar.llm.review_plan()`). `rebar.llm` now exposes `review_plan` / `review_code`, no
`review_ticket`. That removal epic's AC said "the rest [of the 19 referencing test files] are
retargeted to the surviving review-plan/engine paths" — but TWO EXTERNAL live-test modules
were missed:

- `tests/external/test_pydantic_ai_cutover_live.py:80` (`test_pydantic_review_ticket_opus`) —
  run by the external-llm lanes via `pytest -m "external and llm_live" tests/external`.
- `tests/external/test_llm_trace.py:151` — run by the langfuse lane via
  `pytest -m external tests/external/test_llm_trace.py`.

These modules are marked `external` and are EXCLUDED from the standard Gerrit Verified gate
(which collects+skips external tests), so the removal epic's `pytest` run never exercised them
and the regression was invisible until a live `workflow_dispatch` run. Discovered during the
368f Jira-DC harness live run (run 31853325667).

## Fix is NOT a mechanical rename

The old call `llm.review_ticket(epic, "ticket-quality", repo_root=..., config=...)` differs
from the replacement `review_plan(ticket_id, *, ref=None, source=None, repo_root=None,
config=None, ...)`:
- `review_plan` has NO positional `"ticket-quality"` graph-target-kind argument.
- `review_plan` returns a `PLAN_REVIEW_VERDICT`, but both tests validate `schemas.REVIEW_RESULT`
  and assert `result["runner"]`, `result["model"]`, `result["findings"]`.

So retargeting requires an author decision (review_plan vs review_code) plus adapted
assertions/schema. Both external modules must move to a surviving API with the correct result
contract, not a blind s/review_ticket/review_plan/.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `grep -rn "review_ticket" tests/external` shows no call to the removed public API (the
      surviving `operations._review_ticket_impl` engine symbol is a different thing and may stay).
- [ ] `test_pydantic_ai_cutover_live.py` and `test_llm_trace.py` are retargeted to a surviving
      public op (`review_plan` or `review_code`) with assertions/schema matching that op's
      actual result contract.
- [ ] A live `workflow_dispatch` of "Live External Integration" shows the `external LLM (*)`
      and `langfuse tracing round-trip` lanes GREEN (or the retarget is validated equivalently).

## Testing

- `pytest -m "external and llm_live" tests/external` and
  `pytest -m external tests/external/test_llm_trace.py` (require live LLM creds).
- A `workflow_dispatch` of "Live External Integration" is the authoritative check.
data.title: External live tests call removed rebar.llm.review_ticket -> 4 CI lanes fail
